audit_member_text: CONSTRUCT_HO_X and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y use TMP1/TMP2 under IMPLICIT NONE around L1519-L1550 and L1662-L1690, but their local declarations list only TXP/TYP, DVP, VAN1/VAN2, and RAT. Whether PARAM accidentally supplies shared TMP scratch is external; if it does not, compilation fails, and if it does the routines are unexpectedly non-reentrant.

audit_member_text: Use-before-assignment across conditionals occurs in every Cartesian/ZALPHA reconstruction family. U4xL/U4xR and V4xL/V4xR are produced only inside IF(DISPERSION) near L428-L433, L803-L808, and L1305-L1310, but PL/PR/Fx/Gx consume them unconditionally immediately afterward. The same pattern affects U4y/V4y and QL/QR/Gy/Fy. With DISPERSION false, stale or undefined reconstructed arrays enter fluxes rather than the nondispersive formulas used by the nested non-ZALPHA branch.

The high-order reconstruction loops access Vin/MASK at Ibeg-2 and Iend+3 or Jbeg-2 and Jend+3 while dummies are declared only as M-by-N arrays. Safety relies on an unstated caller halo-width/interior-index contract.

VANLEER_LIMITER's two-argument form divides by ABS(A)+ABS(B) without a zero-denominator guard, and its one-argument form divides by 1+A without guarding A=-1. Current slope callers appear to gate the two-argument case by a positive product, but the function interface itself does not enforce those preconditions.

Several routines use I, J and TMP scratch without local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE; their availability through PARAM/GLOBAL makes loop state and reentrancy dependent on module-level declarations rather than explicit routine contracts.
